violations.description: Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --In-use utensil was not properly stored during pauses in food preparation or dispensing. -Scoop handles were sitting in spice bins.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned adequately. -Clean shelving in walk in coolers.--Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned adequately. -Clean outside of toaster oven. -Clean lower shelving in back prep area. -Clean all dry storage shelving.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. -Floors throughout kitchen, storage and in walk in coolers need cleaned.

Food display and service. — --Potentially hazardous food was not kept at an internal temperature of 41F or below during display or service. -Sushi on buffet at 59F. Hold at 41F or below or dispose of after 4 hrs. -Cooked shrimp and potatoes sitting out at 60F. Keep hot at above 140F or cool immediately to 41F or less.

Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --In-use utensil was not properly stored during pauses in food preparation or dispensing. -Ice scoop handle was laying in ice bin.
General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Nonfood contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in a good repair or sound condition. -Shelving in dry storage is rusty.
Plumbing system. — --Plumbing system was not designed, constructed, operated and/or maintained according to regulation. -Main handwash sink in kitchen is dripping.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not maintained in good repair. -Floors in walk ins and in storage areas need painted.--Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. -Kitchen floors need cleaned more thoroughly.
